name: Nagara (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Nagara town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a horizontal band with pointed ends.
history: Municipal flag of Nagara, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1963.

features.role: Nagara town emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal band with pointed ends
